title: The Migration
text: Billing moves from the data centre to the cloud. Its old firewall rule let it in by address, and that address is gone.
held: Billing was recognised in its new home for what it is, not where it is.

cards.label: Refuse to issue
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

slip.title: Identity request from a new location

fields.label: node
fields.value: a cloud node, first seen today

fields.label: attested as
fields.value: the same billing image and service account
fields.check: Attest the workload on its new node
fields.ok: Same billing image, same service account, new node.

intrusion.value: a different image using billing's name
intrusion.why: A move is when things get waved through. A new image with an old name is not billing.
intrusion.reveal: The workload on the new node was a different image using billing's name.

cards.label: Refuse the connection
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: source
fields.value: a cloud address the ledger has never seen

intrusion.value: none: only a request to be let in as before
intrusion.detail: No certificate. The caller asks to be allowed because it “used to be on the list”.
intrusion.why: The address list was never identity, and now it isn't even accurate. No certificate, no connection.
intrusion.reveal: The connection from the new address presented no identity.

temptations.label: Add the whole cloud address range to the allow list
temptations.why: Everyone else's workloads live in that range too. An address rule that wide is an open door.

teaches: Identity that travels with the workload survives a move. Address rules don't.
Migrations are when exceptions get granted. The checks are the same on day one.

question.text: Before play: which idea is this scenario testing?
question.why: The address changed and the workload didn't. Only an identity tied to the workload itself still means anything.

options.label: Identity comes from what a workload is, not where it runs
A firewall rule is enough between services
